skill_name: Write a story of a dog and a cat who become best friends.
workflow: Once upon a time, there was a dog named Max and a cat named Fluffy who lived in the same house. At first, they were complete strangers and seemed to be unable to get along. But one day, Fluffy and Max were out in the garden, and something magical happened. They suddenly got curious about each other and started to play together.
